text: How many times a year should a bank look at your face?
prefix: How many times a year should a bank look at your face?

text: For Aziz, this year, the answer is once, and after that only when something new happens.
prefix: For Aziz, this year, the answer is once, and after that only when something new happens.

text: In Lesson 15, Aziz passed a full proofing in the mobile bank: his document and his face, compared with the state records.
prefix: In Lesson 15, Aziz passed a full proofing in the mobile bank: his document and his face, compared with the state records.

text: This lesson shows what the platform keeps from that day, so that the next check is short, and so that most days have no check at all.
prefix: This lesson shows what the platform keeps from that day, so that the next check is short, and so that most days have no check at all.

text: Start with what MyID gave back, next to the identity.
prefix: Start with what MyID gave back, next to the identity.

text: After a successful proofing, MyID issues a reusable identifier for Aziz.
prefix: After a successful proofing, MyID issues a reusable identifier for Aziz.

text: It is valid until a date in the contract between the bank and MyID, for example the end of the month or the end of the year.
prefix: It is valid until a date in the contract between the bank and MyID, for example the end of the month or the end of the year.

text: The platform keeps the identifier and its expiry date with Aziz's verified identity.
prefix: The platform keeps the identifier and its expiry date with Aziz's verified identity.

text: It never sends it to the phone.
prefix: It never sends it to the phone.

text: Eight months later, Aziz's phone falls into a river.
prefix: Eight months later, Aziz's phone falls into a river.

text: His identifier is still valid.
prefix: His identifier is still valid.

text: He buys a new phone, installs the mobile bank, and types his number and his password.
prefix: He buys a new phone, installs the mobile bank, and types his number and his password.

text: The new-device code arrives by SMS, through TAF, and the verdict is green.
prefix: The new-device code arrives by SMS, through TAF, and the verdict is green.

text: His old phone, at the bottom of the river, cannot approve the login, so after the configured waiting time the correct code is enough.
prefix: His old phone, at the bottom of the river, cannot approve the login, so after the configured waiting time the correct code is enough.

text: Now the platform sees a customer who was at level two, on a device that it has never seen.
prefix: Now the platform sees a customer who was at level two, on a device that it has never seen.

text: So it asks for MyID, but not for everything.
prefix: So it asks for MyID, but not for everything.

text: This is a re-check.
prefix: This is a re-check.

text: Aziz passes the consent gate again, because every call to MyID needs it.
prefix: Aziz passes the consent gate again, because every call to MyID needs it.

text: The platform opens the session with the reusable identifier already set.
prefix: The platform opens the session with the reusable identifier already set.

text: The MyID screen skips the document, and goes straight to the camera.
prefix: The MyID screen skips the document, and goes straight to the camera.

text: MyID checks that the face is live, and compares it with the person behind the identifier.
prefix: MyID checks that the face is live, and compares it with the person behind the identifier.

text: It sends back a match result, and no profile.
prefix: It sends back a match result, and no profile.

text: The platform keeps the match confidence, the references and the time, and the identity data does not change.
prefix: The platform keeps the match confidence, the references and the time, and the identity data does not change.

text: The new phone becomes his trusted device.
prefix: The new phone becomes his trusted device.

text: It took Aziz one look at the camera.

text: So which kind of check comes when?
prefix: So which kind of check comes when?

text: The platform decides, from the purpose and from the identifier.
prefix: The platform decides, from the purpose and from the identifier.

text: A step-up from level one to level two is always a full proofing: there is nothing to compare with yet.
prefix: A step-up from level one to level two is always a full proofing: there is nothing to compare with yet.

text: A refresh of the identity is always a full proofing too, because its job is to read new data.
prefix: A refresh of the identity is always a full proofing too, because its job is to read new data.

text: A new device, or a dormant account, of a customer who was at level two, gets a re-check while the identifier is valid.
prefix: A new device, or a dormant account, of a customer who was at level two, gets a re-check while the identifier is valid.

text: When the identifier has expired, it gets a full proofing with the personal identification number already set, so the screen still goes straight to the face, but the platform receives a full profile.
prefix: When the identifier has expired, it gets a full proofing with the personal identification number already set, so the screen still goes straight to the face, but the platform receives a full profile.

text: A yellow verdict from TAF, for a customer who was at level two, follows the same rule: a re-check before the login continues.
prefix: A yellow verdict from TAF, for a customer who was at level two, follows the same rule: a re-check before the login continues.

text: And one more rule: the platform never sends a customer at level two, with a valid document, to MyID for any other reason.
prefix: And one more rule: the platform never sends a customer at level two, with a valid document, to MyID for any other reason.

text: No channel, no app and no partner can start a proofing for him.

text: I think this rule matters more than the re-check itself.
prefix: I think this rule matters more than the re-check itself.

text: Every call to MyID costs the bank money, and every extra face check teaches customers to show their face whenever an app asks.
prefix: Every call to MyID costs the bank money, and every extra face check teaches customers to show their face whenever an app asks.

text: Prove once, then bind.
prefix: Prove once, then bind.

text: The platform keeps no face template, and it runs no face engine of its own.
prefix: The platform keeps no face template, and it runs no face engine of its own.

text: MyID checks that the face is live, and the platform keeps only the result.

text: What about the side apps?

text: Aziz also logs in to the marketplace app on his new phone.

text: A side app never asks for MyID at login.

text: His marketplace session starts at level one, and it gets level two only after he approves it in the mobile bank.

text: Prove once also works inside a single journey.

text: Suppose that a step-up stops right after the result from MyID arrives, because the app closed.

text: Within the configured reuse period, the platform completes the step-up with that same result, with no new call to MyID.

text: After the period, a new proofing is necessary, and a result is only ever used for its own purpose.

text: To recap: the reusable identifier stays in the bank, a re-check compares only the face, a step-up and a refresh always read the full profile, and nobody may send a proofed customer to MyID for nothing.
